mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 38 degrees and clear over Fireman's Park under a First Quarter moon. At 7:22 PM tonight, look up for a quick one-minute ISS pass rising from over Cross Plains and heading toward Madison, remaining low near the horizon. Expect clear skies overnight with a low of 30 degrees and no rain.

In city updates, the Plan Commission has a pending site plan and conditional use permit review for Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park. Also, the municipal court reminds residents that O W I citations require a court appearance or attorney consultation rather than advance online payment.
There are currently no community events listed on the city calendar for the upcoming thirty days.

For the weekly police report, on Friday, officers stopped two thirteen-year-old juveniles riding prohibited e-motos on Ashton Drive, resulting in citations for both parents for permitting minors to operate the vehicles.
Head over to Culver's before 10:00 PM tonight to grab a scoop of today's flavor of the day, Mint Explosion.
